g.text: For zero-copy event transport, each bridged event sample in LoLa shared memory
stores an 8-byte length prefix followed contiguously by the full SOME/IP message
(16-byte SOME/IP header + payload). Writable_payload::wdata() and Payload::data()
reference this contiguous full SOME/IP message span.
Allocate LoLa shared-memory slot and read full SOME/IP message from network
Publish event update via gateway_ipc_binding over LoLa shared memory
and write payload.data().size() into sample prefix
Receive event in gatewayd, verify E2E over contiguous Payload::data(), and forward
E2E check over contiguous full SOME/IP message
dropping SamplePtr and returning the LoLa slot.
